summary: Phase 2 (Broken Payload Diagnostics + Favorites) fully validated. All backend regression suites pass (67/67) and 5/5 new live-API tests against the public URL pass. Frontend renders BROKEN PAYLOAD DIAGNOSTICS card correctly for AES payload, and the new /history segmented view control (ALL / FAVORITES / RECENT) plus renamed legacy '⭐ FAVORITES' checkbox all work. Workspace panels remain undisturbed. YARA remained untouched (Phase 3 deferral honoured).
critical_code_review_comments: Segmented view tabs (view-tab-*) share the static className 'mono' and rely on inline styles for the active indicator. State transitions work correctly (chk-history-favorites toggles as expected on tab click), but adding an 'active'/'aria-pressed' attribute would make automated testing and accessibility more robust.

Live /api/decode/smart end-to-end latency for the AES payload was ~5-7s per call. Deterministic diagnostic pass is fine, but confirm this stays inside the async job SLA when the panel is opened for the first time.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 (Broken Payload Diagnostics + Favorites view) is certified. Backend suites executed: test_broken_payload_diagnostics.py 7/7, test_pe_analyzer.py 7/7, test_iedde_ssot_wiring.py 7/7, test_iedde_endpoint.py 8/8, test_iedde_stage2_stage3.py 22/22, test_binary_terminal_state.py 4/4, test_pr212_canonical_evidence_recovery.py 13/13 (aggregate 67/67 in a single parallel run).
